description: Source code implementing the dwarf2reader::DieDispatcher class, managing DWARF debugging information entries (DIEs) and their handlers.

classes.name: DIEDispatcher
classes.description: Manages the dispatching of DWARF DIE (Debugging Information Entry) events to appropriate handlers, maintaining a stack of handlers for nested DIEs.

methods.name: StartCompilationUnit
methods.description: Begins processing a compilation unit with specified parameters.

methods.name: StartDIE
methods.description: Handles the start of a DIE, managing handler stack and determining appropriate handler for the DIE.

methods.name: EndDIE
methods.description: Handles the end of a DIE, finalizing handler processing and popping from the handler stack.

methods.name: ProcessAttributeUnsigned
methods.description: Processes an unsigned attribute of a DIE.

methods.name: ProcessAttributeSigned
methods.description: Processes a signed attribute of a DIE.

methods.name: ProcessAttributeReference
methods.description: Processes a reference attribute of a DIE.

methods.name: ProcessAttributeBuffer
methods.description: Processes a buffer attribute of a DIE.

methods.name: ProcessAttributeString
methods.description: Processes a string attribute of a DIE.

methods.name: ProcessAttributeSignature
methods.description: Processes a signature attribute of a DIE.
